Starbucks Com (SBUX) Market Valuation Rose While Baltimore-Washington Financial Advisors Decreased by $525,825 Its Position; Matthews International Capital Management Cut Its Holding in China Lodging Group LTD (HTHT) by $6.96 Million
May 13, 2018 - By Peter Erickson
Baltimore-Washington Financial Advisors Inc decreased its stake in Starbucks Corp Com (SBUX) by 9.78% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Baltimore-Washington Financial Advisors Inc sold 9,225 shares as the company’s stock rose 0.28% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 85,110 shares of the restaurants company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.89 million, down from 94,335 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Baltimore-Washington Financial Advisors Inc who had been investing in Starbucks Corp Com for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $79.03 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.66% or $0.38 during the last trading session, reaching $57.27. About 5.24 million shares traded. Starbucks Corporation (NASDAQ:SBUX) has risen 0.40% since May 13, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 11.15% the S&P500.
Matthews International Capital Management Llc decreased its stake in China Lodging Group Ltd (HTHT) by 24.3% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Matthews International Capital Management Llc sold 48,300 shares as the company’s stock declined 10.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 150,500 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $21.74 million, down from 198,800 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Matthews International Capital Management Llc who had been investing in China Lodging Group Ltd for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $11.00 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.77% or $1.15 during the last trading session, reaching $151. About 312,465 shares traded.
